name: Input Fusion
author: icyleaf
description: Fuses fcitx5 input-method control, hypr-input-switcher rules, and Bloom Rime packages into one Omarchy bar widget and overlay.

barWidget.description: Live fcitx5 input method and Rime schema status; click to switch.

schema.label: Show Rime schema on bar
schema.description: Append the current Rime schema name to the bar label while the Rime input method is active.

schema.label: Switch to Rime when picking a schema
schema.description: Selecting a Rime schema switches fcitx5 to the Rime input method first.
